selection_basis: Four logistics tasks with true-correct oracle/official health, complete single-step packets and bounded public inputs. electric_medical_waste_lrp and container_gate_dro_appointment_planning are newly checked; portable_battery_swap_rebalancing and offshore_wind_maintenance were preregistered reserves. None has participated in specification learning, Qwen engineering trials or memory promotion. synchromodal_freight_recovery and medical_supply_dro_response were excluded solely for oracle quality/health before Qwen evaluation.
